
This is a comparison of average daily PP using model BIOv2 and input data of different composite length (monthly, 8day, and daily). The output is total daily primary production (mg C / m<sup>2</sup> / day), averaged over the month or 8day period for monthly/8day input composites. All of these models use VIIRS-SNPP and a uniform biomass profile in the water column. The PI parameters were calculated by taking the median of the parameters from the BIOv1 input file for this date and the NWA region (i.e. using a single alphab and pmb for the entire region).  

The percent difference between composites are mapped, with a table of Pearson's correlation coefficients between percent difference and three variables: chla, latitude, bathymetry. Note that the density plot x-axis range is the mean +- 2stdev.  

`% difference = (100 * (x - y) / y)`  
x = short composite  
y = longer composite  


## Results {.tabset}

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

out = NULL
# Set knitr options to allow duplicate labels (needed for the subpages)
options(knitr.duplicate.label = 'allow')
# Create temporary environment which we use for knitting PP_comparison_child.Rmd
subpage_env <- new.env()

for (i in 1:length(dates_bio_monthly)) {
  
  date_bio_monthly <- dates_bio_monthly[[i]]
  date_bio_8day <- dates_bio_8day[[i]]
  date_bio_daily_8day <- dates_bio_daily_8day[[i]]
  date_bio_daily_month <- dates_bio_daily_month[[i]]

  # Assign filtered data and product group to subpage_env 
  assign("date_bio_monthly", date_bio_monthly, subpage_env)
  assign("date_bio_8day", date_bio_8day, subpage_env)
  assign("date_bio_daily_8day", date_bio_daily_8day, subpage_env)
  assign("date_bio_daily_month", date_bio_daily_month, subpage_env)
  assign("col_limits_pp", col_limits_pp, subpage_env)
  assign("col_limits_pdiff", col_limits_pdiff, subpage_env)
  
  # Knit PP_comparison_child.Rmd using the subpage_env and add result to out vector
  out = c(out, knitr::knit_child('PP_comparison_child_03.Rmd', envir = subpage_env))
  
}

```

`r paste(knitr::knit_child(text=out, quiet=TRUE), collapse = '')`
